The Chinese characters for Samuel

As a transliteration, Samuel is usually written 塞缪尔 (Sāi miù ěr). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

塞
Sāi
block, fort
缪
miù
entwine (transliteration)
尔
ěr
you, thus

Origin and meaning

Samuel comes from Hebrew and means “heard by God”.

About the name Samuel

In the Bible, Samuel was the prophet who anointed the first kings of Israel.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Samuel carries the meaning “heard by God” and looks striking in brush strokes.
